draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.25, the 73rd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 5th of 18 at S. He went 82nd overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 13 tackles in 2024, 18th of 18 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 10 career games and 6 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 0.0% (99th percentile). Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 safety who played: 29.5% season snap share against a median of 24.1%, above the norm.
